scripts.dev: node -e "import('node:http').then(({createServer})=>import('node:fs').then(({createReadStream,existsSync})=>{const pathMap=(url)=>url==='/'?'client/public/index.html':url.startsWith('/src/')?'client'+url:'client/public'+url;createServer((req,res)=>{const path=pathMap(req.url.split('?')[0]);if(!existsSync(path)){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8'};const ext=path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('.'));res.setHeader('Content-Type',types[ext]||'application/octet-stream');createReadStream(path).pipe(res);}).listen(5173,'0.0.0.0',()=>console.log('Solo Adventuring: http://localhost:5173'));}))"
